means.example-sentence: If it were not for music, our lives would be dull and boring.
means.sentence-jp: もし音楽がなければ、私たちの生活は退屈でつまらないだろう。

cloze.maskedText: ____ music, our lives would be dull and boring.

notes: 「もし〜がなかったならば」と過去について仮定する場合は、if it had not been for ~。やや文語調の形として、それぞれ were it not for ~, had it not been for ~ もある。
